digest.component_or_area: bridge workflows (reconcile-bridge.yml, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml) and core push adapter
propositions: Both workflow-local CAS loops must be removed and replaced with single complete core push action invocations.
Strict synchronous workflow delivery must preserve red failure behavior while library/MCP retain best-effort defaults.
Reconciler identity and exact commit subject must be preserved across the migration to core push entrypoints.
Stale synthetic raw-git exemption rationale in test_raw_git_write_lint.py must be replaced with generic reviewed-fixture rationale.
Executable workflow tests must validate strict synchronous push behavior, rejection handling, and commit identity for both reconciler and canary workflows.
Standing decisions in workflow YAML blocks must document that both workflows invoke strict synchronous core-owned delivery with proper override of sync.push=off.
